📰 News
After more than three years in development, and six months of regular Early Access updates...
Rogue Hex version 1.0 is finally here!



If you visit the Credits section, you'll see nearly 100 names from the Rogue Hex community. As I scrolled through thousands of messages to compile them, I felt an overwhelming wave of gratitude. You've contributed countless suggestions, bug reports, and brilliant ideas to breathe life into this eccentric game.



Thank you to everyone who connected with Rogue Hex.



I'm incredibly proud of version one. We've come so far from the Ancient era...
And there's still so much left to explore!



See you after the credits roll.

🙇 Reed

notes.title: 🏰 Patch 0.5.1
notes.content:
Medieval Patch 1
The Medieval Era's first patch is here. It brings more Developments for your cities, new Steam features, and a few mechanical changes to improve the game's balance. The update also marks the official launch of the Rogue Hex community wiki. Let's jump in.

✨ Features
• 7 new Developments: Armory, Glassworks, Parapets, Buttress, Garrison, Strider, Round Table
• New Trait: Anatomizer
• New Card: Re-Engage
◦ Cheers @Eerokah & @MelficeBelmont
• New Cards: Wrath, Volley
• New cloud shader
• Improved UI for drafting panels
• Reduced game build size
• Improved performance
• Steam Cloud Save
• Steam Achievements
• Rogue Hex Wiki launch

⚖️ Changes
• Cards now go into the "Play Pile" when you play them. All cards in the Play Pile are discarded at the end of your turn.
◦ This change aims to balance powerful draw abilities like Spark and Teapot that were creating infinites too easily. It also creates fun opportunities for new cards that interact with the Play Pile such as Volley.
◦ Shoutout to @Dp101, @MelficeBelmont, @PuszekSE, @RabbitOfCaernabog, @JeBus, @Stardust974, @DemonLLama, @Arthune, and everyone else who contributed to the discussion on Discord!
• Some cards now remove obsolete versions from the Library when you discover them For example, discovering Hoplite removes Warrior.
◦ Thanks @Deee and @PuszekSE
• Improved City focus panel with more info
• Migrants now gives an Inhabit+ instead of increasing the nearest city’s Population
• Added 1 Labour cost to durable strategic resource cards (IE Lumber, Jerky…)
• Unit tooltips now display Max Health and Piercing.
• Changed Frame Cap setting to a new VSync toggle.
• Cities are now smarter about offering you useful Developments to choose from.
◦ Arigato @Dp101

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Potential fix for d3d11 texture crashes (VSync)
◦ Huge thanks to @Chitt411
• Charms now work during multiple rounds without restarting the app
◦ Thanks @Carneggy
• Fixed edge cases that could prevent achievements from unlocking
◦ Shoutout @Dp101
• Fixed scroll bar issue when clicking between units with lots of actions
◦ Cheers @Arthune
• Traits that upgrade skills are no longer abusable via Undo
• Magic Pencil charm is now safe to use
◦ Thanks to @Niemand

Cheers to all the knights in our community helping to test the Medieval era.

The Renaissance era is up next...
Go join the Discord so that you can play it early!

⚔️✨
Reed

notes.title: 🏰 The Medieval Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the Middle Ages!
With two hours of content and three full eras to explore, this update marks the half way point for the Rogue Hex alpha.

✨ Features
• Enter the Medieval Era
• Discover 26 new technologies
• New mechanic: Status Effects
• Redesigned Storage mechanic
• Connect your cities with roads to earn bonuses
• Twelve new Buildings
• Six new Units
• Five new Wonders
• Eight new Developments
• Eight new Relics
• Eleven new Traits
• Five new Achievements
• Too many new cards to count…

⚖️ Changes
• The Undo button is back
	…but it may cause bugs in some cases. Use it with care.
• Leftover Gold and Faith now expire each turn
• Reworked Silver currency into Diamonds
• Units gain fatigue when you pay plans to move them
• Units must now be in your territory to upgrade
• Reroll cost is now shared between all sources, resetting each turn
• Reduced sequential labour cost increase to draw cards from doubling to Fibonacci
• Reduced sequential food cost increase to expand from doubling to linear
• You can lock structures like Villages and Encampments to prevent accidental captures
• You can expand onto tiles with Windfalls to collect them with your city
• You may Visit villages in your cities by clicking on them
• Reduced the size of the map
• Tons of balance changes
• Barbara can now advance to the Renaissance Era

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Fixed a bug that could cause save files to fail
• Unit stat mods and traits now load correctly
• Strategic resources reveal when advancing eras & loading games
• Fixed an issue that caused barbarian units to appear stuck between tiles
• Upgrading units no longer destroys their mounts
• Cost of upgraded Settler cards now displays correctly
• Lots of crash fixes and stability improvements

Up next: the Renaissance era.
See you in the Discord!

⚔️✨
Reed

notes.title: 🏛️ The Classic Update
notes.content:
Salve and welcome to the Classic Update!
With over 2x the content, the new demo offers an hour+ of gameplay per run.

✨ Features
• Welcome to the Classical Era
• Explore 30 new technologies
• Introducing Barbara, the barbarian leader
• Barbarians are smarter & stronger
• New mechanic: Sentry
• New mechanic: Flanking
• Pay gold to upgrade obsolete units and buildings
• New & improved wonders
• Build roads to connect your cities
• Unit stat: Piercing
• Upgraded GUI art & effects
• Improved fog of war tile texture
• Five new Units
• Seven new Developments
• Twelve new Buildings
• Six new Relics
• Ten new Traits
• Dozens of new Cards
• Control Villages with your city for bonus resources
• Level up your leader to unlock new cards and relics
• Complete achievements to earn Quirks

⚖️ Changes
• Cavalry class units are now Tanks, slow & strong armored units
• Anti-cavalry class units are now Anti-Armor units
• Reworked Spearman into Hoplite
• Tile resources give bonuses when controlled by your cities
• Scouts may now attack with 3 base damage
• Wonders are now unique
• Rebalanced city growth levels
• Temporarily disabled the undo button. It will return.
• New relic icons
• Improved Achievements
• Upgraded (meta progression) Upgrades
• Too many card balance changes to list…

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Fixed a ton of soft locks and crashes.
    Heads up: rare locks & crashes might still happen.
• Solved a bug that prevented achievements from unlocking after the first game in each session
• Developments now save & load correctly
• Completing actions you can’t afford is no longer possible
• Movement and vision modifiers now save & load
• You can no longer spam to force multiple attacks
• Undoing card draw now works as expected
• Settler cost now resets correctly if you undo playing the card
• Tooltips hidden behind other objects can no longer activate
• Removed a 1px gap at the top of the GUI
• Breaking changes automatically clear affected save files
• Camera pan locks when the application is minimized or a menu is open

And we're just getting started...
Be sure to join our Discord community so that you can be the first to try the Medieval era!

⚔️✨
Reed
